failure_summary.description: Agents chose a salient nearby detail or repeated part of a clue instead of satisfying the full clue and its requested answer slot.
The answer included unnecessary modifiers when the requested answer was the broader subject category.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already directs agents to match the full clue, identify its target, solve linked readings, and give only the requested answer. These failures reflect not following those rules rather than a missing general rule, so no edit is warranted.
